_doc: Merge policy for .claude/bin/merge_gate.py (/ship). A PR is squash-merged only when, all bound to its exact head SHA: it targets `base`; verify-head --ci says VERIFIED; title and body carry no tool attribution; and the independent review the script runs on an isolated snapshot of that SHA ends in a single `VERDICT: APPROVE` with no CRITICAL/HIGH line. Since 2026-11-14 the session ships every path except the founder's product spec (ROADMAP.md decision D3); the trial list is empty and its date is in the past. `tools` are absolute paths; children get a scrubbed environment with `child_path` as PATH.
